purpose: Research knowledge for rebuilding Content Atelier content-angle discovery and selection
authority_note: Supplied handbook is design reference; new examples, thresholds and implementation choices are proposals. Derived reasoning is not founder approval.

source.title: WIA Content System Handoff
source.locator_kind: OOXML body block and table row; not page numbers

records.title: Select a valuable idea before developing copy
records.understanding: The system must explain why a conversation deserves to become WIA content. Relevance and accurate summarization alone are insufficient.
records.reasoning: A polished brief can still leave Whitney supplying the missing strategic idea. The unit of success is a supported point a relevant prospect would value, not a count of completed fields or attractive hooks.
records.build_implication: Separate opportunity discovery and selection from briefs and finished copy. Review central points first.
records.acceptance_check: Can a reviewer identify the audience significance without relying on the hook or rewriting the central point?

records.title: Keep the exchange the reasoning and the wider significance connected
records.understanding: The source supplies a concrete exchange; the analyst identifies the decision or reasoning it reveals; the angle expresses its broader significance for a defensible audience.
records.reasoning: “Messaging matters” loses the distinctive scene. “Never say no posing” misses the broader collaborative work. Zooming out should reveal meaning while retaining the example that makes it credible.
records.build_implication: Require a traceable chain from source exchange to demonstrated reasoning to central point and intended shift.
records.acceptance_check: The angle is neither a transcript paraphrase nor a generic principle that could have been generated without the source.

records.title: Serve awareness trust and offer understanding over time
records.understanding: Content should reach relevant people, build confidence in WIA's judgment, and make appropriate offers understandable. Education, supported opinions, founder perspective, process, and proof all have a place.
records.reasoning: Commercial value can accumulate through trust and changed understanding. Requiring a sales argument in every item would narrow discovery and make useful founder content formulaic.
records.build_implication: Give each direction a clear primary audience effect; allow an absent offer connection or immediate buying action.
records.acceptance_check: The selection reason explains a marketing purpose without appending a product name as justification.

records.title: Keep the knowledge prompt examples and feedback separately maintainable
records.understanding: The handbook consolidates reference knowledge, angle decisions, examples, application requirements, and references to separate prompt/schema/test assets. New examples and thresholds remain proposals.
records.reasoning: Facts, preferences, approved decisions, and suggestions change under different authority. A single permanent prompt blob makes stale offer details and model-written examples look equally authoritative.
records.build_implication: Version distinct knowledge collections and record provenance, scope, status, and effective date. Treat the seven-file inventory as a proposed package composition, not proof that all seven files were delivered.
records.acceptance_check: A proposed framing cannot be retrieved as “Whitney-approved wording,” and changing an offer record does not require rewriting examples.

records.title: Respect experienced wedding business owners
records.understanding: The audience includes venues, photographers, planners, videographers, and other wedding professionals, many of whom already understand marketing and their strengths. Possible situations include inconsistent inquiries, uncertain booking attribution, unclear campaign strategy, poorly communicated strengths, and limited follow-up capacity. These are segments, not universal assumptions.
records.reasoning: Beginner assumptions can make technically correct education feel irrelevant or patronizing. The audience needs a useful decision, perspective, or explanation at an appropriate level of depth.
records.build_implication: Model audience situations as possible segments, not universal deficits. Specify what an experienced owner gains from the point.
records.acceptance_check: The angle does not assume every reader lacks leads, marketing knowledge, or an articulated differentiator.

records.title: Choose the broadest audience that preserves the insight
records.understanding: The recording participant and content audience are different fields. Some examples transfer across wedding services; others properly remain venue-specific or technical.
records.reasoning: Automatically copying the participant's profile narrows useful process content. Automatically broadening to “all wedding pros” erases constraints that make a specialized point true.
records.build_implication: Store source participant separately and explain why the central point applies to the proposed audience.
records.acceptance_check: Broader relevance follows from transferable reasoning, not from transferring a particular client's results to others.

records.title: Treat wedding buying as distinctive without inventing universal psychology
records.understanding: Couples commonly make a meaningful, wedding-specific choice, compare options, imagine an experience, and seek confidence. Decision windows and routes vary.
records.reasoning: These characteristics explain why relevance and trust matter, but do not establish fixed research durations, a mandatory sequence, or scientific behavioral laws.
records.build_implication: Retain service and situation qualifiers in buyer reasoning. Use decision-stage examples as illustrations where supported.
records.acceptance_check: The system does not claim every couple spends months researching or must pass through three campaign stages.

records.title: Recognize founder thinking and team expertise accurately
records.understanding: The handbook describes Whitney's 12-year wedding/events background and broader strategic thinking. Other team members' recommendations can also demonstrate WIA's expertise.
records.reasoning: Founder content is a perspective, not a requirement that Whitney personally performed every action. Accurate attribution makes collaborative work credible.
records.build_implication: Store the contributing speaker, organizational attribution, and permitted narrator separately. Use “I” only for Whitney's actual experience or perspective.
records.acceptance_check: A Carmen or Danielle recommendation is not converted into “I told my client” in Whitney's voice.

records.title: Advertising starts with business and buyer understanding
records.understanding: Advertising strategy begins with intended couples, their values, positioning, and the reasons a business is a meaningful choice. The message and destination matter alongside platform execution.
records.reasoning: An ordinary copy or imagery discussion can reveal consequential strategic work. The content should show the specific relationship involved, rather than repeat a checklist of every marketing foundation.
records.build_implication: Look for the decision connecting buyer understanding to a campaign or page choice. Keep foundational help within WIA's role.
records.acceptance_check: “Ads amplify businesses” does not become an instruction that prospects must solve all foundational issues alone before seeking help.

records.title: A communication gap does not mean the owner lacks a differentiator
records.understanding: Owners may clearly describe their strengths in conversation while their marketing fails to convey those strengths to couples.
records.reasoning: Misdiagnosing the owner's knowledge changes both the message and service promise. WIA helps develop and translate clarity, rather than requiring a finished UVP as admission criteria.
records.build_implication: Separate “business knows its value” from “marketing communicates that value.” Preserve client insight as a contribution.
records.acceptance_check: The system does not frame WIA as rescuing an ignorant owner or send a prospect away to resolve positioning independently.

records.title: Collaboration is evidence of expertise
records.understanding: WIA's technical expertise and the client's knowledge of buyers, service, and market inform the same decision. Useful questions can be the main content opportunity.
records.reasoning: Agency value does not require originating every insight. Asking the question that changes or bounds a recommendation shows judgment and makes the experience of working together tangible.
records.build_implication: Identify what each participant contributed and the decision that followed. Extract question–answer–reasoning sequences.
records.acceptance_check: A process angle includes WIA's actual question or response and credits the client knowledge it uses.

records.title: Keep business metrics and advertising attribution distinct
records.understanding: Clicks, inquiries, booked consultations, bookings, revenue, and ad-attributed revenue are different measures.
records.reasoning: A compelling business improvement does not automatically identify its cause. Conflating metrics creates false proof even when the underlying number is real.
records.build_implication: Capture metric, unit, period, baseline, source, approximation, and attribution alongside any result claim.
records.acceptance_check: Total bookings are not relabeled as ad-generated bookings; a recollected inquiry anecdote is not computed into an ad conversion rate.

records.title: Systems support the owner's work rather than remove all participation
records.understanding: Systems may connect inquiry steps and reduce supported manual work while the owner serves clients. Automation does not guarantee sales or eliminate human service work.
records.reasoning: The value is a concrete workflow and its supported benefit. “Everything runs itself” exaggerates scope and hides owner responsibilities.
records.build_implication: Identify the automated steps, required inputs, owner tasks, handoffs, and any observed workload change.
records.acceptance_check: A scheduling or follow-up feature is not turned into a guaranteed booking outcome or fully outsourced sales function.

records.title: Fit recommendations to the particular business
records.understanding: Goals, budget, stage, offer, and audience shape strategy. Advertising hesitation and broader founder observations deserve context rather than blanket judgments.
records.reasoning: A useful case illustrates how WIA thinks; it does not establish a universal campaign structure or prove hesitant owners have a poor mindset. Founder and cultural observations can be relevant without being forced into ad-platform advice.
records.build_implication: Preserve the factors behind the choice and distinguish interpretation from verified public facts.
records.acceptance_check: The system avoids universal prescriptions, invented public speculation, and claims that all advertising is frustrating or all hesitation reflects mindset.

records.title: ELEVATE makes ongoing strategic work tangible
records.understanding: The handbook describes ELEVATE as an ongoing done-for-you advertising partnership, potentially encompassing planning, Google/Meta management, creative, advertising pages, tracking, and LeadLock follow-up.
records.reasoning: These work steps can support solution-selling content. Their presence in a reference does not prove each is included in every client's contract or that historical delivery is current.
records.build_implication: Link a demonstrated task to a dated verified offer record and actual contracted scope before claiming delivery.
records.acceptance_check: No guarantee of bookings, complete business management, or universal contracted inclusion is inferred.

records.title: Ads Accelerators are guided implementation
records.understanding: The handbook describes three-month guided Google Search, Meta, or combined implementation paths, including positioning, initial development, support, and interpreting data.
records.reasoning: Reducing the offer to a video course hides the hands-on value; claiming current terms from a past sales call ignores freshness. Guidance can help clients develop clarity rather than require it beforehand.
records.build_implication: Represent support and implementation separately from curriculum and verify current duration, inclusions, and availability before publishing specifics.
records.acceptance_check: Neither “self-serve course” nor “you must already have solved your UVP” is used as the default explanation.

records.title: LeadLock knowledge and specific demo evidence have different roles
records.understanding: LeadLock is described as an inquiry-management/follow-up platform, with connected forms, tracking, pipelines, email/SMS automation, and supported scheduling. It is generally required for ELEVATE, with rare exceptions.
records.reasoning: Product knowledge can support a general demo, but cannot establish which feature impressed a particular prospect. A feature, configured workflow, and outcome are distinct claims.
records.build_implication: Version capabilities and configuration evidence separately. Retrieve reaction-linked demo turns before attaching a prospect endorsement.
records.acceptance_check: Historical exceptions are not promised as the normal offer, and enthusiasm is not treated as proof of purchase or results.

records.title: Respect service scope around branding and sales
records.understanding: Positioning work can inform a designer; WIA is not thereby a visual-branding agency directing logos, fonts, and colors. Advertising does not establish full-service sales management.
records.reasoning: Broader strategic framing should expand the significance of demonstrated work, not expand the services the business promises.
records.build_implication: Include an offer-scope check when central points or drafts imply who owns a downstream task.
records.acceptance_check: A page-messaging example is not sold as a full visual identity service or guaranteed click-to-booking delivery.

records.title: Keep changing facts in dated records
records.understanding: Prices, availability, policies, team information, program/campaign specifications, numerical results, and public events need appropriate current verification. The handbook deliberately omits prices.
records.reasoning: Historical examples can demonstrate editorial judgment while carrying stale facts. Recency of the handbook alone does not independently verify every offer statement.
records.build_implication: Record verified date, applicable scope, status, and superseding record. Gate publication-specific details on the latest applicable source.
records.acceptance_check: Historical pricing and staff details are not silently copied into current marketing.

records.title: Keep Savannah strategy distinct from founder expression
records.understanding: Savannah's strategy governs purpose, packaging, distribution, and CTAs. Whitney's founder voice governs expression.
records.reasoning: A recurring founder theme is not a new pillar. A voice preference cannot replace the marketing job of the content.
records.build_implication: Retrieve strategy and voice as separate inputs with separate ownership and versioning.
records.acceptance_check: The application retains ATTRACT/WARM/CONVERT and does not invent additional pillars from recurring beliefs.

records.title: Assign one primary pillar by audience effect
records.understanding: ATTRACT creates relevant attention; WARM builds trust and understanding; CONVERT clarifies offer value and fit. Content type is a separate dimension.
records.reasoning: The same process can build trust or make an offer concrete, depending on the intended point. Listing every pillar evades the editorial choice.
records.build_implication: Require one primary pillar, an established content type, and a purpose-specific rationale.
records.acceptance_check: A process example classified as CONVERT actually explains useful delivery or fit rather than merely mentioning WIA.

records.title: Discover alternatives without quotas or cosmetic relabeling
records.understanding: One recording may support several distinct directions, or none. Multiple directions must differ in central point or intended shift. Fixed pillar percentages and weak output quotas are not authorized.
records.reasoning: Three rewritten titles do not demonstrate broader discovery. Forcing a mix encourages invented opinions, trends, or proof.
records.build_implication: Group related source treatments, compare their audience effect, and return fewer selections with gaps when necessary.
records.acceptance_check: Changing the hook, client name, or pillar label alone cannot count as a new angle.

records.title: Use Savannah's sequence after selecting the idea
records.understanding: Finished content follows Hook → Problems, Desires, or Symptoms → Main Point → Transformation → CTA, adapted to purpose and format.
records.reasoning: Transformation can be changed understanding when results are unavailable. This is a drafting structure, not a requirement to invent a before-and-after result during discovery.
records.build_implication: Keep this structure in format-specific development; carry evidence limits forward.
records.acceptance_check: A process story can describe a useful thought shift without fabricating increased bookings.

records.title: Earn the CTA and give captions an additional job
records.understanding: CTAs follow the idea and current campaign objective. A reel caption should add context, an implication, or a fitting offer connection rather than repeat the reel.
records.reasoning: Default ELEVATE/LeadLock/“DM ADS” endings make otherwise useful content repetitive and detach the response from its purpose.
records.build_implication: Leave CTA optional at discovery and select it during development using the current plan. Track caption contribution separately.
records.acceptance_check: The CTA is justified by this piece, and the caption contributes something beyond a paraphrase.

records.title: Confidence should come from reasoning and specificity
records.understanding: Desired expression is calm, warm, curious, clear, specific, and respectful. The reader should understand the reasoning behind the conclusion.
records.reasoning: Confidence does not require provocation or certainty about unmeasured outcomes. Source notes can bound facts while the perspective itself remains clear.
records.build_implication: Evaluate framing for understandable significance and natural reasoning, not just punchiness. Keep factual qualifications attached to evidence.
records.acceptance_check: The angle feels useful to an experienced owner without academic phrasing, hype, or a hesitant disclaimer in every sentence.

records.title: Match first person to the actual source of experience
records.understanding: “We/our” describes WIA's work; “I” describes Whitney's personal experience or perspective when she is the source.
records.reasoning: Writing in a founder voice can falsely make another team member's work autobiographical.
records.build_implication: Preserve attribution through narrator selection and drafting, rather than applying a universal first-person style rewrite.
records.acceptance_check: Organizational storytelling does not invent Whitney's participation in a call.

records.title: Vary openings without manufacturing drama
records.understanding: Observations, questions, supported opinions, verified results, and relevant industry moments can open content. Surprise and controversy are optional.
records.reasoning: Always opening with a client conversation is another formula. Copying transcript fillers also confuses evidence fidelity with finished voice.
records.build_implication: Preserve verbatim dialogue in evidence while allowing varied, source-faithful public expression.
records.acceptance_check: The batch does not rely on identical openings or add unsupported cultural speculation for attention.

records.title: Reject formulaic hype and academic framing
records.understanding: Avoid default “not X, Y” reversals, secrets, growth-hack language, generic lead-struggle openings, manufactured consensus, sweeping agency criticism, academic titles, em dashes, and forced fragments.
records.reasoning: These constructions can disguise a weak point or exaggerate authority. The preferred move is to state the concrete observation and its significance naturally.
records.build_implication: Use this as framing review after strategic selection. Do not reduce taste to a banned-word filter or force every ad-investment story into frustration.
records.acceptance_check: Removing a cliché still leaves a substantive, supported idea with a real audience reason.

records.title: Use precedence without erasing the history
records.understanding: The handbook's precedence is latest explicit Whitney instruction, current verified strategy/offer records, established guidance, historical approved examples, then model suggestions.
records.reasoning: Historical approval is contextual; later explicit corrections may reject old constructions. A rejection of one technical angle is not a ban on technical education.
records.build_implication: Keep superseded records and case-specific scope. Apply a reusable rule only when feedback establishes one.
records.acceptance_check: A dated correction wins over conflicting historical wording, without turning one case into an invented global preference.

records.title: Understand the recording before selecting sentences
records.understanding: Identify call purpose, business, goal, decision, contributors, and whether the material describes proposed work, completed action, or reported results.
records.reasoning: A sentence can be accurate yet mislead when removed from the decision it belongs to. Context often contains the team's actual reasoning.
records.build_implication: Produce a recording-context record and extract linked exchanges with enough surrounding turns to preserve meaning.
records.acceptance_check: A proposed workflow is not described as implemented, and material speaker ambiguity is resolved or held.

records.title: Inspect all five handbook lenses
records.understanding: The lenses are WIA expertise, process/collaboration, offer value, audience insight, and proof/transformation. They guide inspection, not output quotas.
records.reasoning: Different source moments have different uses. Client-only reactions can be valuable intelligence; verified changes in understanding can support a story without numerical results.
records.build_implication: Allow multiple lenses per exchange and internal findings alongside public candidates. Preserve proof-specific metric/attribution checks.
records.acceptance_check: The pipeline finds supported useful material outside straightforward educational explanations and does not force a result lens onto every call.

records.title: Retrieve WIA's contribution before claiming a process demonstration
records.understanding: State the client's problem, WIA's observed contribution, and the relevance to a prospect. A client-only excerpt requires retrieval before claiming WIA performed the fuller process.
records.reasoning: Knowing WIA offers messaging help cannot fill a missing response in a particular recording. Audience research remains useful even when agency contribution is absent.
records.build_implication: Mark contribution as observed, missing, or unnecessary for the particular claim; request the precise surrounding segment when needed.
records.acceptance_check: General brand knowledge is not used to fabricate what WIA did in this exchange.

records.title: Develop one defensible central point and audience shift
records.understanding: A candidate has one point, a relevant audience, and something that audience should understand, believe, or do afterward.
records.reasoning: Intended shift is more flexible than an immediate decision and more useful than a generic promise to “build authority.” It distinguishes adjacent treatments from duplicates.
records.build_implication: Make intended shift explicit; merge argument and take into central point. Attach offers only where they follow from the idea.
records.acceptance_check: The intended shift can be expressed specifically without requiring a buying action or manufactured tension.

records.title: Give every useful finding an explicit disposition
records.understanding: SELECT develops a supported worthwhile point; REFRAME redirects useful material; HOLD names a material evidence gap; INTERNAL retains research/service value; SKIP explains insufficient opportunity.
records.reasoning: A single call can yield different dispositions. Product enthusiasm may merit a retrieval hold while a price objection remains internal. Keeping objections is part of honest learning.
records.build_implication: Return dispositions with reasons and relevant next actions, rather than only a flat list of public angles.
records.acceptance_check: Missing material is visible and actionable, and inconvenient product feedback is neither suppressed nor forced into a public lesson.

records.title: Check eligibility before comparing editorial scores
records.understanding: Invented results, material misattribution, unsupported product claims, and current-instruction contradictions make the candidate ineligible until corrected. The proposed rubric has six dimensions.
records.reasoning: Relevance cannot offset an unsupported central claim. Evidence strength and editorial appeal answer different questions.
records.build_implication: Apply a factual/instruction gate first, then score audience relevance, strategic value/brand fit, distinctiveness, appropriate depth, voice/framing, and source support.
records.acceptance_check: A high average cannot admit an invented endorsement or result.

records.title: Treat scoring thresholds as calibration proposals
records.understanding: The handbook proposes 1/3/5 ordinal anchors, intermediate 2/4, prioritization at least 4 on audience/strategy/distinctiveness, revision for any 1/2, and HOLD for material unsupported claims.
records.reasoning: These are judgments, not approval probabilities or marketing forecasts. The source expressly leaves calibration open; there is no defensible invented approval-rate target yet.
records.build_implication: Preserve individual dimensions, anchor-based reasons, and policy version. Calibrate against actual founder reviews before treating thresholds as final automation.
records.acceptance_check: A score of 4 is not shown as “80% likely to work,” and a material evidence gap is not averaged away.

records.title: Explain why a selection beats its nearest alternative
records.understanding: Ranking should include a concise reason and a nearest rejected or deferred alternative, considering current plan and recent work.
records.reasoning: Scores alone conceal the judgment Whitney needs to review. A strong direction may lose because an equivalent point was recently published.
records.build_implication: Store alternative central point, comparison reason, and deferral cause. Present concise rationale, not private step-by-step deliberation.
records.acceptance_check: Whitney can understand the choice without reconstructing the whole discovery process or seeing only identical self-scores.

records.title: A selected brief needs development direction as well as evidence
records.understanding: Selected angles need working title/point, why worthwhile, audience/shift, pillar/type, source demonstration, source/claim limits, and how to make the point tangible.
records.reasoning: These fields support a selected idea rather than establish its eligibility. Development direction should explain the example or sequence to show, without prematurely generating a hook or script.
records.build_implication: Use a concise selected-angle contract with an expandable evidence/development section.
records.acceptance_check: A writer can develop the point without guessing what example substantiates it or inventing missing delivery steps.

records.title: Tension offer connection and immediate decision are optional
records.understanding: Real tension, offer connection, format, and secondary direction are optional. Argument/take merge; mechanism becomes source demonstration and development logic; reader decision broadens to intended shift.
records.reasoning: A process story can earn attention through useful visible work without conflict. Mandatory tension pressures the model to invent a problem; mandatory buying action suppresses founder perspective and trust content.
records.build_implication: Allow explicit null optional fields; require a meaningful intended shift and source demonstration instead of filler.
records.acceptance_check: A worthwhile process angle remains valid with no tension, offer, CTA, or immediate buying decision.

records.title: Separate speech action interpretation and outcome
records.understanding: A recommendation proves reasoning was expressed, not implementation. A prospect reaction is audience evidence, not a measured outcome. Interpretation should be identified as such.
records.reasoning: Process content needs no fabricated success story to justify it. Claims become misleading when a proposed next step is narrated as a completed result.
records.build_implication: Attach an evidence state and supported scope to each material claim, not just one blanket disclaimer for an angle.
records.acceptance_check: “Suggested adding a comparison” never silently becomes “added it and improved conversion.”

records.title: Preserve measurement qualifications
records.understanding: Keep units, period, baseline, approximation, and attribution. Do not compute causal advertising metrics from untracked recollections or ambiguous prices.
records.reasoning: Precision added by the model can be less truthful than approximate source language. A numerical calculation does not improve an anecdote's attribution.
records.build_implication: Keep verbatim numeric context and require verified supporting records for derived claims.
records.acceptance_check: “Approximately one of four or five inquiries” stays an anecdote, not “a 20–25% ad conversion rate.”

records.title: Credit the source of words artifacts and decisions
records.understanding: Client phrases, existing comparison charts, and insights remain client contributions. Team recommendations remain attributed to the actual speaker.
records.reasoning: Miscrediting makes the agency appear more inventive while erasing the collaborative process the client wants showcased.
records.build_implication: Track proposer, owner of an existing artifact, and WIA's later recommendation separately.
records.acceptance_check: “Authentic, not staged” and Lauren's chart are not credited as WIA inventions.

records.title: Keep material ambiguity local and retrievable
records.understanding: Retrieve original audio or a verified record for ambiguous numbers or phrases that affect the point. Keep uncertainty in evidence notes rather than making every public sentence tentative.
records.reasoning: Confident reasoning and truthful boundaries can coexist. Guessing a plausible correction corrupts the evidence; excessive caution in the title does not resolve missing facts.
records.build_implication: Store the exact ambiguous span, why it matters, required evidence, and whether a narrower claim can proceed.
records.acceptance_check: An ambiguous “$30” is flagged, not expanded into a package price or calculated savings.

records.title: Use real recording locators and do not invent dates
records.understanding: Keep actual call ID/URL when supplied, filename, speakers, and elapsed timestamps. A shared batch label cannot uniquely identify a recording or establish its year.
records.reasoning: Traceability depends on finding the actual dialogue. A polished date label or invented Zoom URL creates apparent precision without retrievability.
records.build_implication: Distinguish batch, source file, recording identity, occurrence date, and elapsed time. Display supporting source turns rather than only opaque IDs.
records.acceptance_check: Evidence can be retrieved through real local/source locators, and missing dates remain unknown.

records.title: Editorial readiness is distinct from public permission
records.understanding: Example directions are proposals. SELECT means supported for editorial development, not approved wording, named-client permission, or publication clearance.
records.reasoning: Permission and evidence answer separate questions. Accepting the handbook does not approve every sample or permit naming source participants publicly.
records.build_implication: Track approved direction, approved wording, naming permission, and publication approval as separate statuses. Default public examples to anonymized treatment when naming is not authorized.
records.acceptance_check: Model-selected and human-approved records are visibly different; local evidence names do not automatically become public copy.

records.title: Imagery illustrates market alignment with a bounded process claim
records.understanding: Carmen confirms focus; Shannon explains Colorado/Florida imagery expectations and prioritizes Orlando. The preferable point concerns choosing imagery for intended couples and using client market knowledge.
records.reasoning: This supports a market-alignment exchange, not a completed image-selection workflow, mandatory regional pages, or lost inquiries. The handbook explicitly holds the detailed process breakdown pending surrounding review.
records.build_implication: Use WARM process/behind-the-scenes as a candidate; retrieve the page-review segment for a fuller demonstration.
records.acceptance_check: HOLD for the detailed breakdown; no “your portfolio is costing you inquiries” claim without additional evidence.

records.title: Messaging illustrates service interpretation and needs WIA response
records.understanding: Shannon explains why “no posing” misrepresents her service and supplies “authentic, not staged.” The broader direction concerns helping couples understand the actual experience through collaborative messaging review.
records.reasoning: Client clarification is source support; WIA's response is needed to demonstrate the complete process. This may merge with imagery if both produce the same central point.
records.build_implication: HOLD for missing WIA contribution; keep client authorship. Compare imagery and messaging on intended shift before retaining both.
records.acceptance_check: No agency-invented phrase, final-copy approval, or conversion gain is inferred.

records.title: Keyword discussion demonstrates a particular decision process
records.understanding: Carmen asks whether “light and airy” inquiries become clients and recommends keeping the term under review using Shannon's recollection. WARM process content can show how client knowledge informs technical judgment.
records.reasoning: This is a specific inquiry-context question and provisional recommendation. It does not show the entire research workflow, keyword purchase history, or measured term performance.
records.build_implication: SELECT the bounded process direction; retrieve additional context before describing a complete keyword-research service.
records.acceptance_check: No universal retention advice or ad conversion rate is derived from the anecdote.

records.title: Venue comparison reveals positioning and where to communicate it
records.understanding: Lauren describes comparison with rental-only venues and an existing chart; Whitney suggests the landing page. The point is making value understandable when offers differ.
records.reasoning: The chart is one expression of positioning judgment. Its placement is proposed, and the client created it. Later solution selling needs verified service scope.
records.build_implication: SELECT WARM positioning/process around the recommendation and reasoning; preserve the existing artifact's owner.
records.acceptance_check: No implementation, booking gain, universal cheaper-price claim, or savings calculation from the ambiguous number.

records.title: Campaign planning can directly support solution selling
records.understanding: Whitney explains roles for attraction, conversion, and retargeting creative. The handbook's primary example is CONVERT solution selling: show what venue campaign planning involves.
records.reasoning: A genuine alternative can explore why couples with different familiarity need different information. It must change the audience effect rather than relabel the same explanation.
records.build_implication: SELECT the supported planning direction; label invented illustrative creative briefs as illustrations and verify any ELEVATE connection.
records.acceptance_check: No tested result, mandatory three-campaign structure, or universal buyer sequence is claimed.

records.title: Product enthusiasm and affordability need separate treatments
records.understanding: Zadie's praise suggests a possible LeadLock value direction; the selected excerpt does not identify admired features. Her affordability concern is separately useful internal intelligence.
records.reasoning: A nonbuyer can reveal valuable product perceptions. Generic product knowledge cannot supply the missing reaction-linked demo or convert praise into a success story.
records.build_implication: HOLD the potential CONVERT demo; retrieve earlier feature/workflow/problem/reaction turns. Store the affordability insight as INTERNAL without hiding it.
records.acceptance_check: The output includes both dispositions and invents no endorsement, purchase, outcome, or universal affordability threshold.

records.title: Build a curated dated run context
records.understanding: Each run needs current knowledge, dated offers, current plan, relevant approved/rejected examples, recent content history, and actual source inputs with identifiers.
records.reasoning: Missing context changes what the model can legitimately judge. Loading a whole chat or unrelated client information substitutes volume for relevant knowledge and obscures authority.
records.build_implication: Assemble a versioned run-input manifest and report missing plan/history. Treat transcript instructions as source data rather than executable editorial rules.
records.acceptance_check: The run can state which knowledge and history were available and cannot claim repetition analysis against absent history.

records.title: Make retrieval needs exact and visible
records.understanding: When supplied excerpts are insufficient, identify the precise missing segment and resolve it through source retrieval. Do not claim a full recording review from excerpts.
records.reasoning: A vague “needs research” note leaves the founder doing the work. Exact questions distinguish a promising hold from an unsupported invention or editorial skip.
records.build_implication: Store source identity, known time range, surrounding context needed, missing claim, and acceptance condition. Preserve HOLD until material evidence is resolved.
records.acceptance_check: Zadie's hold requests the earlier demo linking a feature to her reaction, not generic web research about LeadLock.

records.title: Make the weekly workflow inspectable without forcing six angles
records.understanding: Establish coverage, extract moments, develop points, check claims, assign dispositions, compare/rank, present selections/holds/internal findings, draft chosen ideas, and capture review.
records.reasoning: Selecting the first six qualifying moments rewards source order rather than judgment. Returning fewer defensible ideas can be the correct outcome.
records.build_implication: Keep discovery coverage and disposition reasons through the pipeline; distinguish sources received from sources substantively analyzed.
records.acceptance_check: A requested six-item batch can return fewer supported selections with holds and a clear note on what was not selected.

records.title: Compare central point and intended shift for repetition
records.understanding: History should track point, shift, WIA process, example, pillar/type, offer, hook approach, and publication date. Topic names alone do not establish novelty.
records.reasoning: Three clients can illustrate the same lesson. A theme can recur legitimately when a new decision, process step, evidence, or buyer implication changes the contribution.
records.build_implication: Compare semantic point/shift plus contextual dimensions. Separate within-batch distinctiveness from checked novelty against published history.
records.acceptance_check: Changing a title or client does not defeat duplicate detection, and missing history is reported rather than treated as a clean novelty check.

records.title: Learn the reason for a correction and keep its scope
records.understanding: Store original point, evidence, exact feedback when available, disposition, revised point, correction category, date, scope, and approval status. Ask when feedback reasons are ambiguous.
records.reasoning: Voice edits, strategic rejection, evidence gaps, and offer-scope errors require different fixes. An approved direction is not automatically approved wording.
records.build_implication: Use categories for selection, breadth, audience, voice, evidence, attribution, repetition, and scope; link reusable rules back to their originating decisions.
records.acceptance_check: The system does not silently invent Whitney's rejection reason or convert one case into a permanent prohibition.

records.title: Evaluate transfer to unseen recordings rather than title imitation
records.understanding: Start with the six calibration cases, then complete unseen recordings, and then a later held-out batch. Whitney reviews points before hooks and captions.
records.reasoning: Matching six preferred titles can reflect memorization rather than editorial judgment. Strong selection also depends on valuable missed opportunities, not just acceptable generated items.
records.build_implication: Track approval without strategic rewrite, editing effort, high-value misses, unsupported claims, misattributions, duplicates, and disposition accuracy against the original vendor baseline.
records.acceptance_check: Improvements are measured on unseen material; no approval-rate target is invented before the first real review cycle.

records.title: Test degraded and incomplete inputs deliberately
records.understanding: Low-information cases should test missing demos, ambiguous numbers, absent call links, and missing recent history as well as complete recordings.
records.reasoning: These conditions expose whether the system preserves boundaries under pressure to produce content. Correct abstention can be a valuable result.
records.build_implication: Add negative and partial-input cases with explicit expected dispositions and limitation messages.
records.acceptance_check: The model holds missing endorsements, flags ambiguity, creates no fake URLs, and cannot claim history coverage it did not receive.

records.title: Make the opportunity legible before the evidence form
records.understanding: The UI foregrounds central point, why selected, audience, pillar, intended shift, and disposition. Sources, limits, alternatives, and development needs expand beneath it.
records.reasoning: Users need to judge the idea before navigating an academic form. Traceability should remain accessible without dominating the first impression.
records.build_implication: Use concise opportunity cards with an evidence panel containing speaker/timestamp turns and development notes.
records.acceptance_check: A reviewer can assess the central point at a glance and inspect its actual source content without hunting opaque moment IDs.

records.title: Success means reducing missing strategic judgment
records.understanding: The recommended next review is a new ranked weekly batch with reasons, sources, dispositions, and omissions before expanding automated drafting.
records.reasoning: Schema compliance and prompt length do not establish quality. The practical objective is reducing how often Whitney must supply a different strategic idea herself.
records.build_implication: Measure both correctness and founder effort; use the next batch to calibrate the selection mechanism rather than scale script generation immediately.
records.acceptance_check: Report whether the central ideas survived founder review and what valuable opportunities were missed, alongside technical validation.

derived_sections.title: What this taste profile means in practice
derived_sections.markdown:
The handbook supplies these established pillar/type relationships. These are editorial options, not quotas or a publishing schedule.

| Primary pillar | Intended purpose | Established content types |
|---|---|---|
| ATTRACT | Relevant new audience and interest | Polarizing opinions, founder-forward perspectives, campaign breakdowns, trends |
| WARM | Trust and deeper understanding | UVP, thought shifts, processes, behind the scenes, education, founder story |
| CONVERT | Offer value and fit | Solution selling, social proof |

The handbook's preferred content combines a recognizable wedding-business situation with a consequential question or decision. It respects the owner's expertise and shows enough of WIA's reasoning to make that expertise visible. The audience can leave with a clearer belief, a better understanding of the team's work, or a more tangible view of an offer. The point earns its attention through significance and specificity; it need not be surprising, adversarial, educational in format, or explicitly promotional.

The preferred depth is the decision layer. A small exchange can reveal how campaign focus, a buyer-facing phrase, or a keyword recommendation was shaped. The broader point should remain attached to that particular example. WIA's contribution may be a diagnostic question, a constraint it recognizes, a distinction it explains, or a recommendation it adapts after client input. This makes collaborative process valuable even when the client supplied the original phrase or artifact.

A plausible attractive headline is insufficient. “Your portfolio is costing you inquiries” has audience stakes, but its loss claim exceeds the imagery excerpt. The handbook specifically rejects that move without added evidence. Stronger editorial judgment means finding a worthwhile supported point, not strengthening unsupported consequences. Conversely, lack of measured results does not make process content weak: a recommendation can show judgment without becoming proof of improved performance.

The business agenda is qualified demand over time. Some ideas help unfamiliar owners pay attention; others deepen trust; others clarify what a service delivers and whom it fits. A batch of WARM process directions can be legitimate when the available evidence and plan support it. Repeated all-WARM output is a diagnostic question about discovery and inputs, not automatic permission to manufacture ATTRACT opinions or CONVERT proof.

derived_sections.title: Recommended contract for the rebuild
derived_sections.markdown:
This is a derived implementation design, not the missing companion schema from the handbook.

| Record | Fields needed | Why it exists |
|---|---|---|
| Knowledge record | ID, kind, text, source/version, date, scope, authority, verification/approval status, superseded-by | Prevent facts, preferences, and suggestions from being conflated |
| Recording context | Source ID/file, known call ID/URL, supplied date, call purpose, business/goal, participants, coverage extent, ambiguity | Preserve meaning and truth about source coverage |
| Evidence exchange | Turn/span IDs, speaker, elapsed time, verbatim text, surrounding context, contributions, claim state | Support each point with retrievable dialogue |
| Discovery finding | Situation, demonstrated decision/reasoning, broader significance, lenses, source references, possible public/internal uses, exact retrieval need | Search beyond topics before developing a brief |
| Candidate | Central point, intended audience/shift, primary pillar/type, selection reason, disposition/reason, source demonstration, development direction, claim limits | Make editorial judgment visible |
| Optional treatment | Genuine tension, natural offer connection, possible format, distinct secondary direction | Avoid required filler and invented conflict |
| Ranking comparison | Eligibility checks, six dimensional judgments/reasons, nearest alternative, batch/history comparison, plan fit, policy version | Explain why one direction is preferred |
| Human decision | Original point, exact feedback, disposition, revised point, correction category/scope, direction/wording/publication approvals | Learn the actual reason a founder changed the idea |
| Published history | Point, audience shift, process shown, example, pillar/type, offer, hook approach, date, source family | Assess repetition at the level of meaning |

A candidate's editorial disposition should be independent of factual verification and human approval. For example, a supported SELECT can still await public naming permission. A HOLD can be strategically strong but lack material source evidence. INTERNAL is a useful destination, not a low-quality version of SELECT. REFRAME should preserve the useful source while changing the point. SKIP should give a short reason, without filling the gap with an invented angle.

The six proposed scoring dimensions have these handbook anchors:

| Criterion | 1 | 3 | 5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Audience relevance | Mainly the participant's concern | Recognizable segment issue | Clear reason the intended prospect cares |
| Strategic value and brand fit | Generic or misdirected | Pillar supported, WIA value weak | Audience effect and positioning advanced clearly |
| Distinctiveness | Familiar broad lesson | Some specific perspective | Fresh concrete significance and selection reason |
| Appropriate depth | Too technical, shallow, or overloaded | Usable with adjustment | Clear point and sufficient reasoning for an experienced owner |
| Voice and framing | Academic, hype, insulting, or formulaic | Clear but generic | Thoughtful, specific, confident, natural |
| Source support | Central claim absent or contradicted | Partial with precise retrieval need | Supports the proposed claim at its scope |

The initial threshold proposal should remain configurable. Source support of 3 with a material missing segment belongs in HOLD, regardless of excellent relevance or distinctiveness. A supported narrow claim can be developed separately from a broader held claim; the model must state that distinction rather than attach a disclaimer to an unsupported selected point.

derived_sections.title: How the two LLM stages should change
derived_sections.markdown:
**Moment identification:** give the model curated strategy, actual source context, known identities, and coverage constraints. Ask it to identify coherent exchanges across the five handbook lenses, record each participant's contribution, distinguish proposed/completed/reported material, and explain the broader significance. Keep internal research and retrieval holds. Do not require a title, immediate audience decision, conflict, or one moment per call. The extraction should preserve exact dialogue and reference IDs; an interpretation belongs in a separate field.

**Candidate generation and selection:** supply validated exchanges with surrounding context, current offer/plan records, relevant calibration contrasts, and actual recent history. Develop one or more meaningfully different points from strong evidence families. Check claims and current instructions before ranking. Require intended shift, disposition, source demonstration, development direction, and a concise reason against the nearest alternative. Make tension and offer connection optional. Return selected angles separately from holds, reframes, internal insights, and skips; disclose coverage/history limits and source-dependent pillar gaps.

**After selection:** draft chosen content using Savannah's sequence and Whitney's expression rules. Carry attribution and factual boundaries forward. Select CTAs from the actual campaign objective. Founder feedback should update the right knowledge record, not automatically rewrite the entire prompt or promote an illustrative hook into a permanent formula.

derived_sections.title: Differences from the current strategic v1 implementation
derived_sections.markdown:
This section follows the fresh reading above. It is a limited comparison against the current local `wia_strategy.md`, `strategy_contracts.py`, and the saved Week 2 review, not an audit of every UI, SQL, or retrieval path. No runtime change was made for this task.

| Area | Observed current state | Rebuild implication |
|---|---|---|
| Strategic foundation | The v1 reference already emphasizes source-grounded WIA thinking, collaboration, three purposes, and no pillar quotas | Retain these strengths; refine them using the handbook's more explicit boundaries |
| Tension | `StrategicAngleDraft.tension` is required text | Make it optional; a process direction need not invent conflict |
| Intended shift | `reader_decision` is nullable; no dedicated mandatory audience-shift field | Require a specific intended shift while leaving immediate buying decisions optional |
| Dispositions | Moment destinations are public/internal/research; angle readiness is supported/research-required | Add explicit SELECT/REFRAME/HOLD/INTERNAL/SKIP with reasons and next actions |
| Source demonstration | `wia_expertise_in_action` is nullable | Represent the actual supported demonstration, including audience insight or proof; do not require invented WIA action |
| Development direction | No dedicated field in the strategic angle contract | Add the concrete source sequence/example a writer should show |
| Rubric | Five quality fields: grounding, strategic fit, distinctiveness, audience resonance, source strength | Calibrate the handbook's six dimensions; explicitly assess depth and framing rather than equate them with grounding |
| Alternative comparison | Selection reason exists, but no nearest-alternative field in the angle contract | Preserve point-level comparisons and deferrals so ranking is reviewable |
| Discovery lenses | Four contract lenses; process/collaboration and proof/transformation lack dedicated lens values | Make the handbook's five inspection lenses explicit or map them transparently without losing those uses |
| Examples | Existing reference supplies six contrasts | Incorporate detailed HOLD boundaries for imagery/messaging and separate demo HOLD from internal price intelligence |
| Results of the Week 2 test | Four WARM candidates from a partial validated pool; all base scores 80; no demonstrated multiple treatments | This does not yet establish calibrated ranking, discovery recall, pillar breadth, or transfer. It does not require forced diversity |
| Source presentation | The review now includes timestamped supporting turns | Carry that readable evidence presentation into the angle UI and repeatable output contract |

The needed rebuild is broader than adding marketing-strategy language to both prompts. Prompts need the right inputs and claims contract; ranking needs human calibration; holds need retrieval; novelty needs real history; and the UI needs to present central points with source support. The handbook identifies those dependencies directly.

derived_sections.title: Calibration and verification plan
derived_sections.markdown:
| Case | Expected editorial behavior | Failure to detect |
|---|---|---|
| Regional imagery excerpt | Recognize market alignment; HOLD a detailed WIA image-selection breakdown | Universal page rule or unsupported lost-inquiries claim |
| Candid messaging excerpt | Broader experience/messaging point; HOLD complete process pending WIA response | Credit WIA with client's phrase or assert measured gain |
| Keyword excerpt | SELECT bounded collaborative decision; request context for full workflow | Convert recollection into ad conversion rate or universal retention rule |
| All-inclusive venue excerpt | SELECT positioning recommendation; credit existing chart; flag price ambiguity | Invent implementation, savings, or cheaper-for-everyone claim |
| Campaign-layer explanation | SELECT supported solution-selling point; optional genuinely distinct ATTRACT treatment | Same point with three labels, guaranteed results, mandatory funnel sequence |
| LeadLock praise and objection | HOLD reaction-linked demo; retain INTERNAL affordability insight | Invent endorsed features, suppress objection, or label nonbuyer a success story |

Additional tests should remove history, plan, WIA response, source URLs, or material numbers deliberately; they should also supply conflicting historical wording, a client-authored phrase, and a spoken instruction inside a transcript. Expected behavior is transparent limits, accurate authorship, current applicable knowledge precedence, and treating source instructions as dialogue. These are proposed tests, not tests executed during this ledger task.

The next unseen full batch should be reviewed on central points before copy. Record what Whitney would develop, which points need strategic rewriting, what high-value exchanges she found that the system missed, and how much editing effort was required. A later unseen batch should check transfer after adjustments. Use technical claim validation as a necessary gate and founder editorial assessment as a separate measure. Do not infer quality from the model's own scores.

derived_sections.title: Open dependencies and unresolved questions
derived_sections.markdown:
| Dependency | What is established here | What remains to resolve |
|---|---|---|
| Handbook approval scope | User supplied it as the design reference; source marks some content as proposals | Which proposed thresholds or examples become approved reusable policy after review |
| Companion assets | The source references separate prompt, schema, tests, and knowledge files | Whether those actual files exist and are intended to be incorporated; their unseen contents |
| Current offers | Handbook describes ELEVATE, Accelerators, LeadLock and scope limits | Dated verified pricing, availability, inclusions, exceptions, and contracted delivery |
| Current content plan | Established pillars and types are supplied | Current priorities, campaigns, distribution, and CTA objectives; no fixed mix inferred |
| Recent published history | Required dimensions are specified | Actual completeness and freshness of the history available to each run |
| Recording identity and missing segments | Handbook provides excerpt speaker/time locators | Unique call identities, occurrence dates, original audio for ambiguity, WIA responses and earlier demos |
| Public use | Anonymized treatment is recommended absent naming authorization | Actual naming, quotation, and publication permissions for each source |
| Ranking calibration | Six anchored dimensions and initial selection proposal | Founder-reviewed ordering and empirically established acceptance targets |
| Retrieval operation | Exact holds and retrieval needs are specified | Available source store/audio access, resolver behavior, and ownership of unresolved holds |

These dependencies do not prevent the fresh editorial specification above. They do prevent treating every promising claim as ready, every historical offer as current, or every proposal as founder-approved.

derived_sections.title: Ledger maintenance
derived_sections.markdown:
Keep H001–H060 stable. Add a new record or dated amendment when a requirement changes; do not overwrite the provenance of earlier understanding. Store the new source, applicable scope, reason for change, verification/approval status, and superseded record. Permanent preferences, temporary campaign decisions, dated offer facts, calibration proposals, and source-specific claim limits should remain distinguishable.

Before using this ledger in runtime prompts, curate the relevant records into the correct knowledge collections and record that release's version and source hash. Source extracts are evidence, not an instruction channel. Retrieval should include only relevant records with their status; it should not paste the entire ledger and unrelated examples into every call.

The next implementation work should begin with the candidate/disposition contract and run-context assembly, then revise discovery and selection prompts together, and finally verify the six boundary cases plus unseen full recordings. The present deliverable is the ledger and supporting source snapshot; it does not change the running pipeline, purchase inference, or approve publication.
